task_title: Add repo-side gate that fails loudly when README release pin drifts from the latest git tag
task_criteria: 1) make check-readme-release-pin exits non-zero on mismatch naming both values; 2) RED proof: stale pin in README.md makes it exit non-zero; 3) GREEN proof at HEAD exits 0; 4) offline-safe: no network required, loud SKIP when tags unavailable, never silent pass; 5) wired into CI (ci.yml job/step) so a release cut hits it.

items.criterion: 1) make check-readme-release-pin exits non-zero on mismatch naming both values; 2) RED proof: stale pin in README.md makes it exit non-zero; 3) GREEN proof at HEAD exits 0; 4) offline-safe: no network required, loud SKIP when tags unavailable, never silent pass; 5) wired into CI (ci.yml job/step) so a release cut hits it.
items.detail: All five clauses verified by running the code. (1)+(2) RED reproduced live: after `sed -i 's/^V=v0\.3\.0$/V=v0.2.0/' README.md`, `make check-readme-release-pin` printed 'check-readme-release-pin: VIOLATION — the README first-run path is STALE / README pin: v0.2.0 (/home/kara/off-by-one/README.md:460) / latest tag: v0.3.0' plus a remedy line, and make exited 2 (script exit 1, scripts/check-readme-release-pin.sh:151-158); README restored, `git status --porcelain README.md` empty. (3) GREEN at HEAD: `make check-readme-release-pin` -> 'PASS: README release pin v0.3.0 matches the latest tag v0.3.0 (/home/kara/off-by-one/README.md:460)' EXIT=0; `git tag --sort=-v:refname | head -1` = v0.3.0 and README.md:460 is `V=v0.3.0`. (4) Offline: grep for curl|wget|http|git fetch|ls-remote|ssh in the guard returns only comment/SKIP-reason text (lines 8, 135); the only git calls are local (`rev-parse --git-dir`, `tag --sort=-v:refname`, `rev-parse --is-shallow-repository`). Tagless path prints 'SKIP: check-readme-release-pin — <reason>; README pin X not compared against any tag (LOUD skip, NOT a pass)' and exits 0 (script:139-141); git failure exits 2 (script:57-63, 124-128). Non-vacuity proven by `make check-readme-release-pin-selftest` -> 'check-readme-release-pin self-test: 7/7 arms passed — ALL GREEN' EXIT=0 (ARM1 stale pin exit 1 naming both values, ARM2 green, ARM3 loud SKIP with no PASS, ARM4 missing literal exit 2, ARM5 version sort, ARM6 no section exit 2, ARM7 not-a-repo exit 2). (5) CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml:209-222 job `readme-release-pin` (runs-on ubuntu-latest) with actions/checkout@v4 fetch-depth:0 then `make check-readme-release-pin` and `make check-readme-release-pin-selftest`; workflow triggers (ci.yml:3-8) include `push: tags: ['v*']` and `push: branches: [master]`, so a release tag push runs the job; YAML parses via python yaml.safe_load with readme-release-pin in jobs. [resolution 0.00; README.md, ci.yml]

items.criterion: The guard is non-vacuous: it parses the pin from the correct scoped location (first fenced block under 'Install from a release'), so a decoy V= elsewhere in README cannot satisfy or falsely fail it, and a missing section/literal is an error not a pass.
items.detail: Inserted a decoy fenced block `V=v9.9.9` immediately before the 'Install from a release' heading in README.md; `make check-readme-release-pin` still reported 'PASS: README release pin v0.3.0 matches the latest tag v0.3.0 (README.md:464)' EXIT=0 (README restored). Parser is scoped by awk state machine at scripts/check-readme-release-pin.sh:70-92; missing heading -> exit 2 (script:100-104), missing fenced block -> exit 2 (script:105-109), missing V= literal -> exit 2 (script:110-114), all asserted by selftest ARM4/ARM6 which ran green.

items.criterion: The guard is wired into the repo's own gate battery (Makefile .PHONY + target) and passes shellcheck/bash -n so it cannot silently break.
items.detail: Makefile:1 .PHONY lists both check-readme-release-pin and check-readme-release-pin-selftest; targets at Makefile:292-293 and Makefile:299-300. `bash -n scripts/check-readme-release-pin.sh` -> 'syntax ok'; `shellcheck scripts/check-readme-release-pin.sh scripts/tests/check-readme-release-pin-selftest.sh` -> exit 0 with no findings. Both make targets executed green (EXIT=0).

items.criterion: The guard's exit codes are distinguishable: 1 = drift (actionable), 2 = cannot verify (error), 0 = pass or loud skip — and the CI job cannot be satisfied by the SKIP path (fetch-depth: 0).
items.detail: scripts/check-readme-release-pin.sh: exit 1 only on drift (:151-158), exit 2 for README missing (:55-58), not-a-git-repo (:60-63), section/block/pin missing (:100-114) and `git tag` failure (:124-128), exit 0 for PASS (:145-147) or loud SKIP (:139-141). Observed live: drift run -> make 'Error 1' (script exit 1); HEAD run -> exit 0 PASS. CI job pins fetch-depth: 0 (ci.yml:214-217) with an explicit comment that a shallow checkout 'would force the guard onto its loud-SKIP path and make this job prove nothing', so the SKIP path cannot satisfy CI.
